ae5ed1ada1a1e815a2c94077152490ba179b4c4e.summary: A GitHub repository by an individual (cdong1012) containing a Python tool called ContiUnpacker. It uses the Speakeasy Emulation Framework to try to unpack a packed Conti ransomware sample found on MalwareBazaar. The author says the tool does not work fully: only parts of a section are written during emulation, so the dumped executable may not run. The repository page was archived on 2026-11-25. It is a tool write-up, not a vendor threat report.

aef2dbddf215d7c377d8e5999b5bcaf9a248974c.summary: Group-IB's report on Silence, a cybercriminal group that targeted banks and ATMs, mainly in Russia and nearby Eastern European and CIS countries. Phishing emails reached bank employees in more than 25 countries. Documented ATM and card-processing thefts ran from October 2017 to April 2018, with over $550,000 taken in February 2018. Group-IB estimates confirmed damage at about 800,000 USD. Claims about the group's size and insider background are presented as hypotheses. Attribution rests on language, infrastructure and targets.

An early 2017 attribution to state-sponsored or NotPetya-linked actors was not borne out; the report says that hypothesis went unproven.
